buyer_job.action: Attach a falsifiable use and conditional trigger; require the buyer to confirm the actual job and full offer fit.

authorization.action: Link each permission to actor, action, purpose, scope and expiry; account login alone does not establish purchasing authority.

quantity_units.action: Compare explicit compatible mass, volume, count, pairs or hours and minimum order; abstain on bags, density, mixed packs or unconfirmed quantities.

procurement_authority.action: Capture named authorized buyer role and approved procurement stage; distinguish supplier registration from a purchase mandate.

regulated_eligibility.action: Use category-specific eligibility checklists and current authoritative requirements with professional review; exclude unsupported transactions.

compatibility.action: Add structured part, mount, grade, specification and application requirements; exact words or similar photos do not establish compatibility.

capacity.action: Verify seller and recipient capacity for the actual date, duration and load before offering an actionable slot.

document_provenance.action: Retain origin, issuer, observed claim, extraction uncertainty and verification state; obtain seller confirmation before promoting visual guesses.

project_stage.action: Require funded or authorized buying-stage evidence, timeline and current package; a project announcement is context only.

availability.action: Add expiring stock and slot reservations with last-confirmed timestamps; recheck immediately before introduction.

measurement.action: Keep pilot inclusion rules, independent labels, confidence bounds and failures; evaluate accepted pilots and offer-level buyer finding separately.

pilot_authority.action: Record buyer-approved experiment, capped spend, data rights and acceptance test; a generated proposal never authorizes execution.

service_area.action: Preserve explicit seller geography; add verified coverage and travel constraints before expanding search or quoting fulfilment.

product_scope.action: Keep full fit unknown until application and scope are checked; build independent semantic contrast cases including RAM versus ram.

event_date.action: Bind requests to confirmed event time and acceptance deadline; do not use historical event pages as current purchase evidence.

installed_base.action: Obtain permissioned asset model and operating context; distinguish owner, maintainer and authorized replacement buyer.

fulfilment_cost.action: Reject explicit goods subtotals above budget; otherwise require a scoped quote including transport, installation, tax and losses.

intermediary_role.action: Preserve broker, dealer, inspector and end-buyer roles; verify mandate and fees before a specific introduction.

trigger_attribution.action: Link the trigger to the correct legal entity, branch and decision unit; a generic growth story does not establish this requirement.

currency_basis.action: Require explicit currency and comparable unit or total basis; do not guess bare dollars, FX rates or pro-rated lot prices.

contact_permission.action: Use the actual permitted contact channel and purpose; discovery consent and public listing presence are separate from contact permission.

response_attribution.action: Build authenticated responses tied to the specific offer revision and introduction; separate interested, inspected, quoted and paid outcomes.

recurrence.action: Record independently confirmed reorder cadence and next stock requirement; historical purchases are a hypothesis, not a standing order.

aggregation.action: Pool only explicit member orders after checking uniform specifications, combined minimum, allocation, payment and cancellation rules.

member_consent.action: Collect revocable purpose-limited consent from each participating buyer; a group administrator cannot invent members' demand.

rights_scope.action: Verify ownership or licensor mandate, media, territory, duration and exclusivity before proposing a licensable asset.

technical_format.action: Validate buyer-required format, integration contract and acceptance sample; do not call file-name similarity usable fit.

freshness_window.action: Require the actual request date and present need; page modification time does not renew an expired purchase request.

intake_acceptance.action: Confirm recipient intake grade, contamination threshold, measured lot and rejection rules before collection.

workflow_fit.action: Map an authorized buyer's actual workflow and baseline problem to the offered capability; validate through an approved narrow trial.

data_rights.action: Track collection, reuse, retention and training permissions by source; add attributable partner feeds only within granted rights.

implementation_scope.action: Agree migration, integration, ownership, acceptance and ongoing support before presenting software as an executable replacement.

seasonality.action: Check local calendar, agronomic or event window and explicit need; never transfer one region's season into another.

material_identity.action: Require reliable material grade and contamination evidence; unknown recycled feedstock stays unresolved until tested.

trade_eligibility.action: Validate current origin, destination, product and shipment requirements with authorized parties before calling an export route feasible.

offline_coverage.action: Use consented associations, physical-market partners or seller-approved demand forms; report coverage gaps instead of inventing invisible buyers.

language.action: Preserve original language and validated translation, including negation and commercial terms; abstain when meaning is uncertain.

receiving_capacity.action: Confirm receiving date, storage, handling and batch capacity; a nearby business may still be unable to accept the goods.
